description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): make an office code (boj_...) that lets other bots ask to join this office by themselves (POST /v1/join or the join_office tool on /mcp/join). The code is shown once. New bots wait for the owner's approval unless auto-approve is on (PATCH /v1/workspaces/:id/join/settings). Same as POST /v1/workspaces/:id/join/codes. Example: {"label":"n8n bots","expires_in_hours":72,"max_bots":10}.

expires_in_hours.description: Hours until the code stops working (at most one year).

label.description: What this code is for (shown to the owner).

max_bots.description: How many bots may join with it.
